entry_state: Subsequent lease reductions preserve actual surrendered rights; contract-cost impairment precedes measurement of a remaining onerous duty. Tax benefits retain their acquisition, profit or OCI origin. Rule selection now separates operative authority, historical support and adoption dates. ASBE lease and tax adoption follow different clocks; the tax-transition explanation continues.
exit_state: The operating-company methods retain cost histories, subsequent events, tax origins and dated authority. ASBE transition requires both opening and comparative effects. Ping An's adoption balances constrain a history without identifying an equity plug, later payments or a discount rate. Financing, ownership and the group boundary are the next accounting questions.
findings: ASBE tax transition preserves gross deferred balances and comparative reversal; the lease-adoption election does not replace the separate tax-transition rule.
Ping An's 833 opening asset/liability difference is not an identified retained-earnings adjustment. The maturity total and carrying liability have different measurement meanings.
Chapter9 author reading is complete for physical113–176. RR-001 and RR-002 remain confirmed editorial repairs; source, domain and human acceptance stay pending.
